title: Mouthpieces: filing, H1S versus H2S and a stolen mouthpiece
summary: Filed-down mouthpieces are ruined; he describes his H1S and a stolen Selmer mouthpiece.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: What kind of a mouthpiece do you use, Albert? Is it just a standard mouthpiece, or is it a con?
Well, the one I'm using now is a salmon.
Oh, a salmon mouthpiece. Would you say that was probably a little wider than the average?
Does it have a big lay? That is, did anybody ever file it down? I understand some of the New Orleans fellows used to file down that mouthpiece to open it up more between the reeds.

Well, that's the mistake they made, they ruined them. I have a couple of mouthpiece that that fellas ruined like that, that I got, and I couldn't blow them. A couple of mouthpiece that they ruined like that, file them down. Them mouthpiece comes by numbers. You can buy them open.
I've only seen the standard ones, they seem to be kind of...

I went, when I bought this one, I went to the store, and I was to get an H2S, but they gave me an H1S, which is not quite as wide open as the H2S. But after I had it a while, and I thought it was H2S, then I went, I happened to my Peterson to get something done on my phone. And he looked at it, and he said, well, he said, you were supposed to get H2S, it's H1S. But it was H2S that I was supposed to get. But you got used to it, you just as easy. I got used to it, yeah.

I had a regular margillian or a cheap margillian, a big was an imperial. I paid two and a half for that margillian. And they kept telling me about the selmas, the selmas, the selmas. And that was the best margillian I ever had. No, that cheap margillian. And I bought this selma and I was taking it off my horn. I was playing at the Mardi Gras at the time. I had taken it off my horn and kept it in my case. Somebody swiped it out of my case. Somebody swiped it out of my case back there by the Mardi Gras.
Yeah, you wouldn't think anybody would have to... That's a load of steel. I'd steal more than that if we were going to steal something anyway.
It doesn't necessarily depend on the price of the mouthpiece. No. No. No.
